caption: The drawing features two oval-shaped objects placed side by side horizontally within a rectangular frame positioned in the center of a larger, otherwise blank page. Each oval object has a border made up of small, triangular or diamond-shaped segments colored in shades of blue, purple, and pale green. Inside each oval is a symmetrical structure with a vertical central line intersected by horizontal and curved bars, resembling a stylized or abstract pattern. The interior lines and shapes are outlined in grey or charcoal tones. The background inside the rectangular frame is a light beige, matching the broader background of the page. The drawings are rendered with soft, shaded coloring and careful line work, with subtle color gradations throughout the border areas.
title: Man's Shoe Buckle
